remarks: Located in the vibrant heart of the NoHo Arts District, this stylish, light-filled contemporary residence offers the perfect blend of design, functionality, and urban convenience. Spanning three levels of thoughtfully designed living space, plus a large private rooftop deck, this home delivers modern living at its best. The second level serves as the main living hub, featuring 9ft ceilings and open-concept layout ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. A sleek gourmet kitchen anchors the space, complete with counter seating, custom cabinetry, designer tile, and a powder room, all complemented by warm oak plank flooring.
